summary:
SPACE POP is an interactive Earth science jukebox that transforms NASA Earth Information Center (EIC) satellite datasets into accessible, musical soundscapes.
Built as a web application, SPACE POP features 12 planetary missions (A1–D3) spanning ocean circulation (SWOT), polar ice elevation (ICESat-2), methane plumes (EMIT), and lightning sferics (ISS-LIS). Selecting a dataset rotates a custom 2D globe to the target coordinates, parts hinged glass doors, and opens an expanded observation window pairing real NASA satellite imagery with a live telemetry graph. Using the Web Audio API, planetary anomalies are translated into harmonic pentatonic scales rather than raw static, balancing scientific data fidelity with musicality.
Designed with accessibility at its core, SPACE POP ensures Deaf and hard-of-hearing users experience the audio through real-time closed captions (CC) displaying exact notes, frequencies (Hz), and a live visual pitch ribbon, while blind and low-vision users benefit from full keyboard shortcuts, ARIA live announcements, and rich visual alt-text descriptions. By turning complex climate data into an inviting, multisensory story, SPACE POP makes Earth science inclusive and emotionally resonant for everyone.
details:
What It Does & How It Works: SPACE POP is an interactive,Earth science jukebox that transforms 12 NASA Earth Information Center (EIC) datasets —including SWOT ocean currents, ICESat-2 polar ice, EMIT methane plumes, and ISS-LIS lightning—into musical soundscapes. Selecting any dataset via the tactile window cards, physical keypad, or keyboard shortcuts rotates a 2D globe to the mission’s coordinates, parts hinged glass doors, and opens a pop-out stage pairing real NASA satellite imagery with a live telemetry graph and procedural Web Audio synthesizer.

Benefits & Accessibility Built with accessibility at its core, SPACE POP enables Deaf and hard-of-hearing users to experience the audio through real-time Closed Captions showing exact musical notes, frequencies, harmonic keys, and a live visual pitch ribbon. Blind and low-vision users can navigate entirely via keyboard shortcuts, ARIA live announcements, and rich text image descriptions. Rather than producing harsh static, planetary anomalies are quantized onto pleasant pentatonic scales with distinct timbres.

Intended Impact By turning complex climate visualizations into an inviting, multisensory experience, SPACE POP makes NASA Earth science emotionally resonant, educational, and universally accessible to students, educators, and people with sensory disabilities.

Tools, Languages & Creativity Developed in VS Code and hosted on GitHub Pages using HTML5, CSS3 (3D hinged transforms and hand-crafted paper-cut borders), Vanilla JavaScript, HTML5 , and the Web Audio API, alongside public NASA SVS, Earth Observatory, JPL, and ISS imagery. Instead of a clinical dashboard, we reimagined data exploration as a nostalgic storybook advent jukebox, balancing scientific fidelity, musical harmony, and inclusive design.
